name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.common.photo.crop.CropImageActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen after a user chooses a photo for a QChat server or announcement icon. It provides a square crop and returns the cropped image for upload.
disableEffect: Users cannot crop a selected photo before setting a QChat server or announcement icon.
